basic_info.description: Dramatic Tribeca-Style Corner Loft within an exclusive gated community in South Beach. This rarely available 2-bed, 2-bath live/work loft offers industrial elegance in a boutique Martin Building Co. development. Featuring exposed architectural steel, industrial loft windows, smooth stucco showers, and polished concrete floors with radiant heat, this loft blends urban charm with modern comfort. Expansive windows and soaring ceilings create an open, light-filled space, while custom steel accents and exposed piping enhance the industrial aesthetic. The open kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances and a Thermador gas range, with a spacious dining area perfect for entertaining. The lower-level library/sitting room can serve as a second bedroom, and the primary mezzanine suite features a walk-in closet, siting area, and office. Additional highlights include remodeled baths, solar shades, linen drapes, ceiling fans, radiant heating, garage stall parking. Shared rooftop deck with a gas grill and stunning downtown views. Located in the heart of South Beach, just moments from CalTrain, Oracle Park, and The Embarcadero. A true one-of-a-kind live/work loft in desirable A+ location.
